note: Stage 4 rebuild empty-weight inputs (AER-3784, MANUFACTURING, 2026-10-24). Signed deltas in lb: light = lightest credible outcome, heavy = heaviest. Grades as in the long list: F factory, T TCDS, P pilot report or flight test, B builder or registry data, R measured record, E our estimate. The engine swap is not among the items; engine_delta_lb is [most saving, least saving] from our per-variant engine check (docs/MANUFACTURING.md#engine-check), on AERO's Aeromomentum rule (dry x 1.25 + 35 lb). Laminate arithmetic behind the composite items is in docs/MANUFACTURING.md#how-the-composite-deltas-are-built.

base.basis: 1,600 standard (F, RAF via pilot report, 337skymaster.com/defiant.htm); 1,680 'equipped, as tested' (P, same report) and VH-DFY 1,680 with IO-360s and glass panel (B, aeropedia.com.au, 2019); Wikipedia 1,701. No weighed builder Defiant found

items.item: Wing, canard, winglets: full-depth hot-wired foam cores with wet-laid glass skins -> molded carbon sandwich skins on spar and ribs, pultruded carbon spar caps
items.basis: Laminate and core arithmetic on AERO's wetted areas (287 ft2): removes 90-120 lb of full-depth foam, adds an inner face, light core and ribs. See the method section

items.item: Fuselage shell: wet-laid glass/foam sandwich -> infused carbon sandwich in female molds
items.basis: 228 ft2 shell; 3 plies wet BID at 0.11-0.12 lb/ft2/ply against 2-3 plies infused 200 gsm carbon at 0.066

items.item: Bulkheads, firewalls, consoles: hand-laid -> CNC-cut from bought carbon sandwich panel
items.basis: about 40 lb of flat glass/foam parts; flat carbon panel about 35-60% lighter

items.item: Finish: micro contour fill and sanding -> in-mold surface, prime and paint
items.basis: Moldless fill 0.06-0.12 lb/ft2 plus paint over 515 ft2, against molded surface paint only. CAFE weighed the moldless Cozy 12% over brochure, the molded IV-P 0.6% (R)

items.item: Panel: 1980s gauges, radios and vacuum system (if fitted) -> EFIS and current radios
